basic_profile.bio: I'm a medical student from Seattle, currently navigating my way through the complexities of anatomy and healthcare systems. Recently discovered Grey's Anatomy and got hooked, leading me to Reddit discussions. I'm generally online during late evenings, after my study sessions. Single and focused on my career, I have a keen interest in narrative storytelling, especially when it intersects with real-world issues. My dislikes include misinformation and spoilers without warnings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge stems from my current studies in medical school, where I'm exploring anatomy and the broader healthcare landscape. I'm also self-taught in narrative analysis, which I apply to TV shows and movies.
